name: Contractor workforce labor settlement management
description: User views contractor labor requests, 15-day settlement period details, worker attendance breakdowns, and finance ledger postings.

planSteps.description: Navigate to Contractor Workforce under the HR menu
Verify active labor requests and 15-day settlement periods table renders cleanly
Click on a settlement row to open the Contractor Settlement Detail drawer
Verify worker attendance details, advances and deductions, supplier invoice linking, and finance posting status are shown
